title: Dependency-ordered Hedgehog issue graph local draft
commands: $graphPath = 'planning\github-issue-graph-v1.json'; $graph = Get-Content -LiteralPath $graphPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($graph.schema_version -ne '1.0') { throw 'unexpected schema_version' }; $seen = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([System.StringComparer]::Ordinal); $gateNames = @($graph.gate_definitions.PSObject.Properties.Name); foreach ($node in $graph.nodes) { foreach ($field in @('id','title','description','priority','workstream','milestone','status','labels','dependencies','gates','acceptance','evidence_types','source_refs')) { if ($null -eq $node.$field) { throw "node $($node.id) missing $field" } }; if (-not $seen.Add([string]$node.id)) { throw "duplicate node id $($node.id)" }; foreach ($dependency in $node.dependencies) { if (-not $seen.Contains([string]$dependency)) { throw "node $($node.id) has unknown or out-of-order dependency $dependency" } }; foreach ($gate in $node.gates) { if ($gateNames -notcontains [string]$gate) { throw "node $($node.id) has undefined gate $gate" } }; if (@($node.acceptance).Count -eq 0) { throw "node $($node.id) has no acceptance criteria" } }; $requiredWorkstreams = @('hardware-characterization','reproducible-infrastructure','security','single-host-inference','network-transport','distributed-moe','scheduling-virtualization','observability-benchmarking'); $actualWorkstreams = @($graph.nodes.workstream | Sort-Object -Unique); foreach ($workstream in $requiredWorkstreams) { if ($actualWorkstreams -notcontains $workstream) { throw "missing doctrine workstream $workstream" } }; $requiredMilestones = @('days-1-10','days-11-20','days-21-30','days-31-40','days-41-50','days-51-60'); $actualMilestones = @($graph.nodes.milestone | Sort-Object -Unique); foreach ($milestone in $requiredMilestones) { if ($actualMilestones -notcontains $milestone) { throw "missing milestone $milestone" } }; "Hedgehog issue graph structural check PASS: $($graph.nodes.Count) nodes; dependencies ordered; 8 doctrine workstreams and 6 milestones covered."

$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'evidence\planning\hh-agy-20260822t194555z-issue-graph.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $repo = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '..').Path; $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); try { foreach ($artifact in $manifest.artifacts) { $target = Join-Path $repo $artifact.path; $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($target); $normalized = $text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n"); $bytes = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes($normalized); $actual = ($sha.ComputeHash($bytes) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) -join ''; if ($actual -ne $artifact.sha256) { throw "hash mismatch: $($artifact.path)" } } } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
